# FurnaceCompare

> FurnaceCompare is a refreshingly different HVAC marketplace platform connecting homeowners with furnace, heat pump, air conditioner, and water heater options alongside local contractor networks and system sizing tools.

FurnaceCompare provides a comprehensive platform for comparing HVAC systems, water heaters, and related equipment while connecting users with qualified local technicians for installation and service. The site combines product comparison tools, sizing calculators, and contractor matching to simplify HVAC replacement and repair decisions.

## Key Topics

- HVAC replacement
- Furnace comparison
- Heat pumps
- Air conditioners
- System sizing
- Local contractors
- Technician network
- Energy efficiency
- SEER ratings
- Air handlers
- Ductwork
- Water heaters
- Contractor matching
- HVAC repair
- Home comfort

## HVAC Equipment Comparison

- [Furnace Comparison & Replacement](https://www.furnacecompare.com/furnaces/): Main furnace comparison and HVAC replacement marketplace platform
- [Heat Pumps & Air Handlers](https://www.furnacecompare.com/heat-pumps/air-handlers/): Heat pump and air handler comparison with sizing calculators
- [Water Heaters & Heat Transfer Products](https://www.furnacecompare.com/mfr/heat-transfer-products/water-heaters/): Water heaters and heat transfer products comparison and marketplace

## System Design & Installation

- [HVAC Ductwork Systems & Sizing](https://www.furnacecompare.com/ductwork/): HVAC ductwork systems, sizing guides, and local technician network

## Reviews & Contractor Matching

- [Furnace Reviews & Contractor Matching](https://www.furnacecompare.com/furnaces/reviews/): Furnace reviews, ratings, and contractor matching recommendations
